newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle near steady - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle near steady - USDA.

text.p: Live Sales Slaughter steers and heifers were near steady, compared to Tuesday's close, USDA said. Trade was moderate. Demand moderate. Seller interest moderate, instances good. Offerings current.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100-1275 lbs 68.50-69.00.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1075-1200 lbs 68.00-69.00 couple lds 69.25.
Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared to Tuesday's close
- Slaughter steers and heifers steady to weak.
